t: 第一次有纪录的赛事是在切斯特赛马场(Chester Racecourse)上举行的,被称为"鲁…
te: The first recorded race is held on Chester Racecourse, known as the Roodee.
dz: 第一次有纪录的赛事是在切斯特赛马场(Chester Racecourse)上举行的,被称为"鲁德".
de: The first recorded race is held on Chester Racecourse, known as the Roodee.

t: 新教徒和神圣罗马皇帝之间的法兰克福条约已经签订.
te: The Treaty of Frankfurt between Protestants and the Holy Roman Emperor is signed.
dz: 新教徒和神圣罗马皇帝之间的法兰克福条约已经签订.
de: The Treaty of Frankfurt between Protestants and the Holy Roman Emperor is signed.

t: Nikolaus Federmann 和 Sebastián de Belalcázar 正式…
te: Official founding of the city of Bogotá, New Granada (nowadays Colombia), by Nikolaus Federmann and Sebastián de Belalc…
dz: Nikolaus Federmann 和 Sebastián de Belalcázar 正式建立新格拉纳达波哥大市（现哥伦比亚）。
de: Official founding of the city of Bogotá, New Granada (nowadays Colombia), by Nikolaus Federmann and Sebastián de Belalcázar.

t: 在佛罗里达州，埃尔南多·德索托 (Hernando de Soto) 带着 600 名士兵登陆…
te: In Florida, Hernando de Soto lands at Tampa Bay with 600 soldiers with the goal of finding gold.
dz: 在佛罗里达州，埃尔南多·德索托 (Hernando de Soto) 带着 600 名士兵登陆坦帕湾，目标是寻找黄金。
de: In Florida, Hernando de Soto lands at Tampa Bay with 600 soldiers with the goal of finding gold.

t: 埃尔南多·德索托 (Hernando de Soto) 声称佛罗里达属于西班牙。
te: Hernando de Soto claims Florida for Spain.
dz: 埃尔南多·德索托 (Hernando de Soto) 声称佛罗里达属于西班牙。
de: Hernando de Soto claims Florida for Spain.

te: Pope Paul III sends out letters to his bishops, delaying the Council due to war and the difficulty bishops had travelin…
dz: 特伦特会:教宗保禄三世向其主教们发来信件,由于战争和主教们去威尼斯所遇到的困难而拖延了会务.
de: Council of Trent: Pope Paul III sends out letters to his bishops, delaying the Council due to war and the difficulty bishops had traveling to Venice.

dz: 舍尔·沙阿·苏里手下的阿富汗苏尔部队在绍萨之战中击败了胡马云手下的莫卧儿军队.
